test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Vyom purchased 40 dozen peas at the rate Rs. 56 per dozen He sold 15 dozen at 20 percent profit and the remaining 25 dozen at 10 percent profit. What is his profit percentage?
solution:
Given:

Vyom purchased 40 dozen pens at the rate Rs 56 per dozen.

He sold 15 dozen at the profit = 20%

The remaining 25 dozen at the profit = 10%

Formula:

SP = CP × (100 + Profit%)/100

Profit = SP – CP

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

Calculation:

Total cost price of 40 dozen pens = 40 × 56 = Rs. 2240

The total selling price of 30 dozen pens :

⇒ 15 × 56 × [120/100] + 25 × 56 × [110/100]

⇒ 1008 + 1540

⇒ 2548

Profit = 2548 – 2240

∴ Profit = 308

Profit % = (308/2240) × 100

∴ Profit % = 13.75%

**The answer is 13.75%**
